name: atc
description: Coordinate exclusive Android emulator (AVD) and physical device leases across concurrent coding agents with the atc CLI, PreToolUse/SessionEnd hooks, and stdio MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate exclusive Android Virtual Device (AVD) and physical USB/Wi-Fi device leases across concurrent coding agents with profile matching, QEMU snapshots, bounded-window warm-affinity queueing, host RAM/disk guardrails, and scoped atc exec heartbeats.
capabilities: Claim and release exclusive Android emulator or device leases
Run adb, Gradle connectedCheck, and android CLI commands with lease heartbeats
Save, restore, and reset QEMU emulator snapshots
Enforce multi-agent guardrails and warm-affinity queueing
defaultPrompt: Claim an API 36 phone emulator with Play Store and run connectedDebugAndroidTest.
Check available Android emulators and active leases with atc status.
